title: The Contender's Gauntlet
narrativeText: To earn a title shot, you must beat whoever they put in front of you. The booker grins. Easy enough for him to say.

choices.label: Accept the Challenge
choices.text: Win this, and the championship match is yours.

title: The Championship Confrontation
narrativeText: The Extreme Championship is on the line. The champion waits — {{CHAMP}}. Everything you've survived underground has led to this single, violent moment.

choices.label: Demand the Title Match
choices.text: No more waiting. The championship changes hands tonight.

title: First Defense
narrativeText: You won the title and the challengers are already lining up. {{RIVAL}} has unfinished business — and a steel chair.

choices.label: Defend Your Championship
choices.text: No one takes this from you without a fight.

title: Extreme Rules Showdown
narrativeText: Another challenger. Another extreme stipulation. The title makes you a target every single night.

choices.label: Accept the Extreme Challenge
choices.text: It never stops. That's fine — neither do you.

title: Contract on the Line
narrativeText: The booker has a new idea: hang a briefcase containing a championship contract above the ring. Win it, and you secure your spot. A ladder match. The crowd is already buzzing.

choices.label: Climb for the Contract
choices.text: Every rung is a battle. The contract is yours.

title: Booker's Ultimatum
narrativeText: The booker calls you into his office. He slides a paper across the desk. 'Sign this or I strip the title.' The paper would give him creative control of your character. The crowd outside is chanting your name, not his.

choices.label: Sign It
choices.text: You need the belt. You swallow your pride and sign.

choices.label: Call His Bluff
choices.text: You tear the paper in half. 'Try it. See what the crowd does.' He backs down.

title: Extreme Gauntlet
narrativeText: The announcement comes with no warning: tonight, you defend against a gauntlet of challengers. They come one by one until you can no longer stand. The crowd is ecstatic. You are less so.

choices.label: Run the Gauntlet
choices.text: Survive long enough and the championship stays yours.

title: Promo War
narrativeText: {{RIVAL}} cuts a promo on cable TV — calling you a paper champion, saying you got lucky, that the title never belonged to you. It airs. The calls start. The booker wants a response by midnight.

choices.label: Fire Back Publicly
choices.text: You call in to the show and say everything. The fans eat it up.

choices.label: No Comment
choices.text: You let actions speak louder than words. Next week in the ring.

title: The Faction
narrativeText: Three wrestlers corner you after the show. Their leader slides you a card. 'Join us. We'll make sure no one touches that title without going through all of us first.' They seem sincere. They are also terrifying.

choices.label: Accept the Offer
choices.text: Numbers matter in the extreme world. You're in.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: You got here alone. You'll keep it that way.

title: Grinding Through
narrativeText: Your knee buckles in warmup. The trainer wraps it, says two words: 'Be careful.' You have a championship defense tonight. The crowd is already in their seats.

choices.label: Push Through
choices.text: Champions don't take nights off. You tape it tight and head to the ring.

choices.label: Rest It
choices.text: You request a one-week postponement. The crowd boos, but the knee needs time.

title: Tables, Ladders and Chairs
narrativeText: {{RIVAL}} drags a ladder down the aisle on their way to the ring. A ring crew member follows with a stack of tables. Someone has informed the crowd this is happening. They are already standing.

choices.label: Embrace the Chaos
choices.text: Tables. Ladders. Chairs. You helped invent this match.

title: Thrown Under the Bus
narrativeText: The locker room clears out fast after your loss. Someone — a person you considered an ally — is on the house microphone, telling the crowd you were never good enough, that the belt was always above your reach. The words echo in the empty hallway.

choices.label: Face It Alone
choices.text: You say nothing. You find a quiet corner and start planning. This is not over.

choices.label: Demand a Rematch Tonight
choices.text: You storm back to the ring. You are not done. Not even close.

title: Standing Ovation
narrativeText: One fan finds you in the parking lot. Then two. Then a dozen. They are still wearing your shirts. One holds a sign: 'WE BELIEVE.' They did not leave when you lost. You are not going to let them down.

choices.label: Channel the Support
choices.text: You shake every hand. You remember why you do this. The comeback starts now.

title: Second Chance Qualifier
narrativeText: The booker posts the bracket: an elimination qualifier. Win it and you re-earn the championship match. The crowd knows what is at stake. They are on their feet before the bell.

choices.label: Fight Your Way Back
choices.text: Elimination. One by one, you take them all down.
